compiled_state.description: Panel O1 (ticket 0734, GO-WITH-CONDITIONS). Eliminate the manual re-stage toil that drives the staged-staleness livelock (lived through dd123-5/-6/-7; 3x version-only PR2 conflicts as main advanced during review churn). Conditions (red-team lens): (1) human-confirm OR forge-side spentness proof before deleting a remote staged ref — the local 0-ahead 'spent' signal cannot distinguish spent from not-yet-populated; (2) flock + ownership scoping on the shared /tmp cache GC (no cross-session sweep); (3) preserve INC-008 trustworthy-read + merged-PR-guard invariants in the new path; (4) ship advisory/dry-run first (print the commands; explicit flag to execute). Ref: docs/designs/two-tier-flow-operational-cost-panel-input.md, 588e-backlog-reconciliation-plan.md N1.
